problem: Cursor lost Gaia LLM after WiFi transition (.147→.246)

diagnosis.likely_cause: Cursor config pointed to old IP .147 or lost localhost binding

fix_for_cursor_settings.step3_option_a: Set OpenAI Base URL to: http://localhost:11434/v1
fix_for_cursor_settings.step4: Set model to: gaia-tissue-forge (best) or gaia-tissue-code (for code)
fix_for_cursor_settings.step5: Set API key to: any-string (Ollama ignores it)
fix_for_cursor_settings.note: localhost always works regardless of IP change — never use LAN IP in local config

cursor_mcp_config.note: If using MCP squirrel, ensure it points to localhost too

architecture.before: Cursor → Claude (cloud) — paid API, data leaks out
architecture.canvas: Cursor's canvas IS Gaia's visual workspace
architecture.desks: Cursor's tabs ARE Gaia's desks — the IDE is the organism's eyes
